name: Ichikai (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Ichikai town emblem in white: a stylised bird-like device with a pointed top enclosing a ring.
history: Municipal flag of Ichikai, a town in Tochigi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 28 November 2003; the emblem dates from 30 July 1961.

features.role: Ichikai town emblem — a stylised bird-like device with a pointed top enclosing a ring
